# Debrief: Argo CD, cert-manager, Envoy, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Istio, Kubernetes

These clips give the team practical guidance on Argo CD patterns and pitfalls, plus cert-manager, Istio ambient mesh, Envoy and Prometheus-related context relevant to their stack. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s); [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 1:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=61s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Use ApplicationSets instead of hand-written Applications or Helm charts that template Applications; one ApplicationSet can replace 50 Applications (five infrastructure apps across ten clusters), and versioning Argo CD Applications is called an anti-pattern. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 14:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=868s))
2. For Argo CD pull request previews, use a dedicated Argo CD instance, not production: the tool creates and deletes applications constantly, which hurts the UI and can overload and crash a production instance. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))
3. Moving to Istio ambient mesh raised ugly side effects for one team using cert-manager and Argo Rollouts: cert-manager's ACME support needs an experimental feature, and Gateway API needs plugins, so tooling must be updated. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit your Argo CD repos for individually written Applications or Helm charts that generate Applications, and prototype replacing them with a single ApplicationSet per cluster category. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 14:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=868s))
- [ ] If you try pull request diff previews, stand up a dedicated Argo CD instance for them, and consider a self-hosted runner if security rules restrict cluster access from pipelines. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))
- [ ] Before evaluating Istio ambient mesh, list tooling affected by Gateway API and cert-manager's experimental ACME support, and check which plugins or settings would need changing. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))

## Watch together (8 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s) (1:22), Regina Voloshin: Concrete ApplicationSet example covering cert-manager, Prometheus and Istio across clusters.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s) (2:21), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Warns against previewing on production Argo CD; suggests dedicated instance.
3. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Candid ambient mesh migration costs involving cert-manager and Gateway API.
4. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s) (1:19), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains ztunnel's role in ambient mesh versus full Envoy proxy.
5. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 17:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=1049s) (1:18), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Istio generating Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry-compatible traces without code changes.
